title: I_MISS_U Unified Intermediate Format Record
description: Validates one Unified Intermediate Format (UIF) record. JSONL files contain one such record per line. All data-source parsers must emit records conforming to this schema before downstream rhythm/persona/memory builders consume them.

envelope.description: Shared envelope fields carried by every UIF record type.

record_id.description: Stable unique id for this record. Recommended form: sha256 hex digest of source export identity plus native id, e.g. sha256('<source>:<native_id>').

record_type.description: Discriminator for the UIF record type. Must match the selected oneOf branch.

person.description: Subject slug, e.g. 'mama'. Represents the person the memory archive is about.

viewpoint.description: Slug of the account owner whose export this record came from, e.g. 'owner'. Use 'self' for the subject's own accounts.

source.description: Original data source or export family.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 date-time with timezone offset, or null when unknown.

timestamp_precision.description: How precisely the timestamp is known.

tier.description: Fact tier: 1 = human-confirmed, 2 = parsed data default, 3 = model-generated or inferred content.

lang.description: BCP-47 language hint, e.g. 'zh', 'wuu' for Shanghainese/Wu.

provenance.description: Provenance metadata explaining exactly where and how this record was extracted.

source_file.description: Path to the original source file, relative to people/<person>/.

parser.description: Name or identifier of the parser that produced this record.

parser_version.description: Version of the parser that produced this record.

native_id.description: Original id of the item inside the source system, if available.

source_account_id.description: Private stable account alias from registry; not a viewer ID.

notes.description: Optional free-form notes about this record.

canonical_event_id.description: Optional strong-evidence event link; never replaces source record_id.

quality.description: Export, speaker and transcript checks are separate; accepted exports are not training approval.

allOf.description: Chat message record (WeChat, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, etc.).

record_type.description: Must be 'message' for this record type.

conversation_id.description: Stable identifier of the conversation containing this message.

sender.description: Sender participant id. Use 'subject' for the person of interest, 'viewpoint_owner' for the account owner, or any other participant id.

text.description: Message text or transcript. Optional for non-text content.

media_ref.description: Path to associated media, relative to people/<person>/, pointing into raw/ or normalized/media/.

duration_ms.description: Duration in milliseconds for voice or video messages.

reply_to.description: record_id of the message this message quotes or replies to.

allOf.description: Social media post or moments record (WeChat Moments, Weibo, Facebook feed, etc.).

record_type.description: Must be 'post' for this record type.

author.description: Author participant id. Use 'subject' for the person of interest or any other author id.

media_refs.description: Paths to media attached to the post, relative to people/<person>/.

location.description: Optional location attached to the post.

likes_count.description: Number of likes on the post, when known.

items.description: A single comment on the post.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 comment timestamp, or null if unknown.

comments.description: Comments on the post, if available.

record_type.description: Must be 'email' for this record type.

from.description: Sender email address or participant identifier.

to.description: Primary recipient email addresses or participant identifiers.

cc.description: Carbon-copy recipient email addresses or participant identifiers.

body_text.description: Plain-text body content of the email.

body_html_ref.description: Path to stored HTML version of the email body, relative to people/<person>/.

media_ref.description: Path to the stored attachment file, relative to people/<person>/.

allOf.description: Standalone media item record (photo, video, or audio file).

record_type.description: Must be 'media_item' for this record type.

media_type.description: Type of the standalone media item.

file_ref.description: Path to the media file, relative to people/<person>/, pointing into raw/.

sha256.description: SHA256 hex digest of the media file.

size_bytes.description: Size of the media file in bytes.

width.description: Pixel width for photos and videos.

height.description: Pixel height for photos and videos.

duration_ms.description: Duration in milliseconds for video or audio items.

exif.description: EXIF or media metadata, when available.

gps.description: GPS coordinates embedded in the media.

caption.description: Optional human-readable caption for the media item.
